risk_title: Incident detection errors may delay or misdirect response
risk_scenario: If automatic incident detection misses a real incident or generates an incorrect detection, incident information may be delayed, misclassified or acted on inappropriately, potentially affecting response.
control_status: Specified at requirement level; implementation and effectiveness unverified
control_evidence_and_limitations: No implementation or configuration evidence, function-specific acceptance thresholds, evaluation results, false-positive/false-negative rates or operational review evidence are available in the reviewed material.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain implementation/configuration and test evidence; define detection categories and acceptance thresholds; evaluate false positives and false negatives across relevant conditions; verify human review, escalation, override and ongoing monitoring.
assurance_test_titles: Incident detection performance and acceptance criteria
assurance_test_objectives: Establish whether detection performance, false positives and false negatives can be evaluated against defined acceptance thresholds.
assurance_test_procedures: Review the defined detection categories, model or analytics configuration, test plan, dataset selection and ground-truth method. If authorised access and a suitable test environment become available, test representative cases across relevant conditions and report results by detection category and condition.
required_assurance_evidence: Approved detection requirements and thresholds; model/configuration documentation; test plan and test cases; representative labelled data or controlled scenarios; results by category and operating condition; finding-remediation records.
recommendation_titles: Establish validated detection and accountable human oversight
recommendations: Define incident-detection categories, operating conditions and approved acceptance thresholds; validate false-positive and false-negative performance; document which outputs may influence protocols or alerts; establish clear authorisation, human review, override, escalation and fallback procedures for consequential actions.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Detection performance is evaluated against approved thresholds; roles and decision points are documented; required review and override mechanisms are evidenced; relevant failure scenarios are tested and findings have documented dispositions.

risk_title: Unverified authorisation and override arrangements for automated protocols
risk_scenario: If the deployed workflow does not provide effective authorisation, review, override and escalation arrangements for automated protocols and multichannel alerts, an inappropriate activation or failure to intervene could lead to a disproportionate, delayed or misdirected operational response.
control_status: Human authorisation, review, override, failure handling and escalation arrangements are unverified; control effectiveness cannot be assessed.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No implementation or operational evidence has been reviewed for the relevant authorisation, review, override and escalation arrangements; general test-plan requirements do not establish that these controls were implemented or tested.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain workflow and role documentation; identify which events or outputs can trigger each protocol and channel; verify approval gates, human review, override/cancellation, fallback handling, escalation responsibilities and logs; review test and incident records.
assurance_test_titles: Authorisation, human review and override of automated protocols
assurance_test_objectives: Establish whether the intended operational workflow provides clear authority, human review where required, escalation, override and fallback arrangements.
assurance_test_procedures: Review workflow diagrams, operating procedures, role assignments and relevant permissions. Walk through scenarios involving a false detection, conflicting information, an urgent priority incident, a communications failure and an attempted cancellation or override. If access is authorised, inspect supporting configuration, logs and test evidence.
required_assurance_evidence: Protocol trigger rules; role and responsibility matrix; approval and escalation procedures; override/cancellation and fallback instructions; access configuration; operator training evidence; relevant audit logs and test results.
recommendation_titles: Establish validated detection and accountable human oversight
recommendations: Define incident-detection categories, operating conditions and approved acceptance thresholds; validate false-positive and false-negative performance; document which outputs may influence protocols or alerts; establish clear authorisation, human review, override, escalation and fallback procedures for consequential actions.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Detection performance is evaluated against approved thresholds; roles and decision points are documented; required review and override mechanisms are evidenced; relevant failure scenarios are tested and findings have documented dispositions.

risk_title: Unreliable predictive analytics may misdirect public-safety planning or response
risk_scenario: If predictive outputs are inaccurate, poorly calibrated or misunderstood, public-safety resources or attention may be directed toward the wrong locations, periods or incidents.
control_status: Evaluation and monitoring controls are specified at a general or requirement level; implementation and effectiveness for the predictive function are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No function-specific validation report, approved performance thresholds, calibration results, uncertainty presentation, data-suitability analysis or monitoring/retraining records have been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the model purpose and target definitions; approved evaluation metrics and thresholds; representative validation results; input/data-quality and drift analyses; operator guidance; monitoring, maintenance and change-control records.
assurance_test_titles: Predictive-model purpose, validation and uncertainty handling
assurance_test_objectives: Determine whether the predictive function is adequately specified and validated for its intended public-safety use, and whether limitations and uncertainty are communicated appropriately.
assurance_test_procedures: First identify the specific prediction target and intended decision use. Review the model development/evaluation documentation, data selection, approved metrics and thresholds, assumptions affecting continued validity, and maintenance/retraining plans. If authorised model access and suitable data become available, assess performance on appropriate evaluation data, including temporal or geographic variation where relevant, and compare results with the approved criteria.
required_assurance_evidence: Model purpose and target definitions; CRISP-DM documentation where applicable; data description and provenance; evaluation methodology and results; RMC approval of proposed metrics and thresholds; calibration or uncertainty documentation where relevant; monitoring and maintenance/retraining records.
recommendation_titles: Validate predictive and event-correlation functions and monitor their reliability
recommendations: Define the purpose and permitted operational use of each predictive and correlation function; document input data, event definitions and provenance; approve suitable evaluation metrics and thresholds; test representative conditions and error scenarios; establish ongoing performance monitoring, uncertainty communication, maintenance and revalidation triggers.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Each function has documented purposes and evaluation criteria; validation results are compared with approved thresholds; correlation errors and source provenance are assessed; limitations and uncertainty are documented; monitoring and corrective-action responsibilities are assigned and evidenced.

risk_title: Incorrect event correlation may combine, duplicate or misclassify incident information
risk_scenario: If the event-correlation function incorrectly links unrelated reports, fails to link reports about the same event, or handles conflicting and delayed source data poorly, operators may receive a misleading incident picture.
control_status: Capability and general test requirements are specified; the correlation mechanism, implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No design description, event-matching rules, conflict/duplicate handling procedures, source-provenance evidence, representative test results or operational correction records have been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the correlation design and event definitions; document sources and lineage; review handling of duplicate, conflicting, incomplete and delayed events; inspect representative test cases/results and correction/escalation procedures.
assurance_test_titles: Event-correlation logic, provenance and error handling
assurance_test_objectives: Determine whether the event-correlation behaviour is specified, testable and supported by evidence appropriate to its intended operational use.
assurance_test_procedures: Review event definitions, correlation rules/model documentation, source mappings, data-quality assumptions, and test plans/results. If authorised test access is available, run controlled scenarios representing same-event reports, unrelated reports, duplicates, conflicting attributes, incomplete records and delayed inputs; compare outcomes with pre-defined expected results.
required_assurance_evidence: Event definitions and matching criteria; source/interface mappings; data dictionary and lineage; approved test cases and expected results; labelled or controlled test inputs; correlation outputs and error logs; remediation records.
recommendation_titles: Validate predictive and event-correlation functions and monitor their reliability
recommendations: Define the purpose and permitted operational use of each predictive and correlation function; document input data, event definitions and provenance; approve suitable evaluation metrics and thresholds; test representative conditions and error scenarios; establish ongoing performance monitoring, uncertainty communication, maintenance and revalidation triggers.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Each function has documented purposes and evaluation criteria; validation results are compared with approved thresholds; correlation errors and source provenance are assessed; limitations and uncertainty are documented; monitoring and corrective-action responsibilities are assigned and evidenced.

risk_title: Public-safety information reused for CRM personalisation without adequately evidenced safeguards
risk_scenario: If incident-related information or interactions are incorporated into unified CRM profiles and used for personalisation or awareness/loyalty campaigns without clearly defined purposes, data boundaries and safeguards, information collected in a public-safety context may be reused in ways affected people do not expect or that are not appropriately limited.
control_status: Purpose limitation, data minimisation, access boundaries, retention, transparency and any separation between public-safety and campaign uses are unverified in the reviewed material.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No data-flow specification, field-level mapping, purpose/legal-basis assessment, transparency material, access matrix, retention schedule or evidence of controls over campaign reuse has been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the cross-module data-flow and field mappings; document purposes, roles, lawful basis and transparency arrangements; inspect access controls, retention/deletion rules, minimisation and separation of public-safety data from campaign use; confirm approval and audit trails for any reuse.
assurance_test_titles: Cross-module purposes, data fields and access safeguards
assurance_test_objectives: Establish whether the documented design limits cross-module processing to defined purposes and whether data transfers and safeguards can be traced.
assurance_test_procedures: Obtain and compare the Public Safety-to-CRM data-flow diagram, field mapping, purpose descriptions and relevant privacy/governance documentation. Trace each specified field to its purpose, recipient, access roles, retention/deletion rule and any campaign/personalisation use. If permitted, inspect configured interfaces, access rules and relevant records to compare actual configuration with approved documentation.
required_assurance_evidence: Cross-module data-flow/interface specification; field-level mapping and data dictionary; purpose and role descriptions; applicable privacy assessment and transparency materials; access matrix; retention/deletion schedule; campaign-use rules; configuration or audit evidence where available.
recommendation_titles: Define purpose, access and retention controls for safety-related and surveillance data
recommendations: Map relevant data flows and fields; document the purposes and recipients of information transferred between Public Safety and the CRM/fidelity module; assess any proposed personalisation or campaign reuse; define and evidence role-based access, export restrictions, retention and deletion rules for relevant video, drone and incident data; document procedures for drone deployment and associated data handling.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Relevant data flows, purposes, recipients and fields are documented; access and retention rules are defined for the applicable data categories; any CRM reuse is explicitly assessed and justified; implementation evidence supports the stated controls; unresolved questions are recorded for decision.

risk_title: Video and drone data may be captured or retained without sufficiently evidenced access and lifecycle controls
risk_scenario: If camera or drone footage and associated telemetry are captured, accessed, exported, retained or reused without suitable purpose, access, retention and review controls, individuals may be monitored or their information exposed beyond the intended operational need.
control_status: Equipment, storage and certain security requirements are specified; actual access permissions, retention settings, deletion controls, drone operating procedures and safeguard effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No as-built camera/drone configuration, access matrix, retention/deletion evidence, export/access logs, operating procedures, data-protection assessment or commissioning evidence has been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain deployment locations and enabled analytics; confirm purpose and necessity for capture; inspect access and export permissions, logging, retention/deletion configuration and monitoring; establish drone deployment/authorisation procedures and how footage and telemetry are handled; review commissioning evidence.
assurance_test_titles: Video and drone data capture, access, export and retention controls
assurance_test_objectives: Determine whether video and drone data handling can be traced to documented purposes, permissions, retention settings and operating procedures.
assurance_test_procedures: Review camera/drone deployment and configuration records, enabled analytics, access permissions, export procedures and retention rules. Verify how the specified minimum 30-day local video storage requirement for critical channels is configured without assuming that this is the appropriate retention period for every data category. For drone operations, review deployment authorisation and footage/telemetry handling. If authorised, sample configuration and logs and test retention/deletion or access controls in a controlled environment.
required_assurance_evidence: Camera and drone inventory/configuration; deployment locations and enabled analytics; purpose and operating procedures; access matrix; export and access logs; retention schedule by data category; deletion/rotation evidence; commissioning records; drone deployment and telemetry handling procedures.
recommendation_titles: Define purpose, access and retention controls for safety-related and surveillance data
recommendations: Map relevant data flows and fields; document the purposes and recipients of information transferred between Public Safety and the CRM/fidelity module; assess any proposed personalisation or campaign reuse; define and evidence role-based access, export restrictions, retention and deletion rules for relevant video, drone and incident data; document procedures for drone deployment and associated data handling.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Relevant data flows, purposes, recipients and fields are documented; access and retention rules are defined for the applicable data categories; any CRM reuse is explicitly assessed and justified; implementation evidence supports the stated controls; unresolved questions are recorded for decision.

risk_title: Security or integration weaknesses may compromise system integrity or availability
risk_scenario: If interfaces between Public Safety and connected municipal systems are incorrectly configured, insufficiently protected or inadequately monitored, unauthorised activity or integration failures could affect the confidentiality, integrity or availability of information used in public-safety operations.
control_status: Security, integration and logging controls are specified at requirement level; implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No interface specifications, deployed access-control configuration, integration test results, security assessment, log-monitoring evidence or remediation records have been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain interface and network documentation; review authentication, authorisation, data validation and error handling; inspect security and integration test results; verify logging coverage, protection against log tampering, alerting and remediation processes.
assurance_test_objectives: Assess whether the documented interface, access-control, logging and integration requirements are supported by implementation and test evidence.
assurance_test_procedures: Review interface specifications, authentication and authorisation arrangements, API security requirements, integration test results, centralised logging configuration and relevant audit/monitoring procedures. If authorised testing is available, execute approved negative and failure-path tests in a controlled environment and verify logging and alert behaviour.
required_assurance_evidence: Interface and network documentation; access-control configuration; API security requirements; integration and security test cases/results; logging configuration and sample events; monitoring and remediation records.
recommendation_titles: Verify connected-system security and service recovery readiness
recommendations: Review deployed interface security, access permissions, integration failure handling, audit logging and security monitoring. Separately verify recording redundancy, backup coverage, recovery objectives, restoration procedures and test results. Require material security, integration or recovery findings to have documented remediation or an approved disposition.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Interface and logging controls are evidenced against applicable requirements; integration and security tests have documented results; backup and recovery coverage is defined; restoration tests demonstrate results against approved objectives; material findings are tracked to resolution or formal disposition.

risk_title: Backup, recording or recovery failures may interrupt public-safety operations or remove needed evidence
risk_scenario: If recording, backup or recovery arrangements fail or cannot restore usable information when needed, operators may lose access to video evidence, incident records or supporting information during an outage or emergency.
control_status: Resilience and recovery controls are specified; implementation, recovery performance and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No as-built resilience design, backup configuration, retention mapping, restoration-test results, recovery objectives or evidence of recovery exercises have been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain architecture and dependency documentation; inspect backup schedules and coverage, storage protection, retention requirements, restoration procedures, test results, recovery objectives and fault-handling records; verify how failures are detected and escalated.
assurance_test_objectives: Establish whether the specified resilience, backup, recording and restoration requirements are implemented and tested.
assurance_test_procedures: Review the resilience design, backup scope and schedules, recording redundancy, retention requirements, restoration procedures, recovery objectives and test results. If authorised, observe or execute a controlled restoration test and compare the recovered data and elapsed recovery time with pre-approved criteria.
required_assurance_evidence: As-built resilience design; backup configuration and logs; recording redundancy evidence; data-category retention mapping; documented recovery objectives; restoration test plan/results; failure and escalation records.
recommendation_titles: Verify connected-system security and service recovery readiness
recommendations: Review deployed interface security, access permissions, integration failure handling, audit logging and security monitoring. Separately verify recording redundancy, backup coverage, recovery objectives, restoration procedures and test results. Require material security, integration or recovery findings to have documented remediation or an approved disposition.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Interface and logging controls are evidenced against applicable requirements; integration and security tests have documented results; backup and recovery coverage is defined; restoration tests demonstrate results against approved objectives; material findings are tracked to resolution or formal disposition.

risk_title: AI performance degradation may go undetected during operation
risk_scenario: If the performance of detection, correlation or predictive functions degrades over time and that degradation is not identified promptly, operators may continue relying on outputs whose quality no longer meets operational needs.
control_status: Monitoring and model-lifecycle requirements are specified at general level; implementation and effectiveness for each function are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No approved function-specific thresholds, baseline evaluations, monitoring dashboards/alerts, drift analyses, maintenance records or evidence of review and corrective action have been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain approved model-specific metrics and thresholds; baseline and ongoing evaluation results; monitoring frequency and alert rules; data/operational drift analyses; responsible review roles; maintenance, retraining and corrective-action records.
assurance_test_titles: Ongoing AI performance monitoring and degradation detection
assurance_test_objectives: Determine whether deterioration in detection, correlation or predictive performance can be identified and addressed during operation.
assurance_test_procedures: Identify each function's approved performance measures and thresholds. Review baseline and ongoing evaluation results, monitoring frequency, input/data drift indicators, alert and review responsibilities, maintenance/retraining records, and examples of corrective action. If authorised operational evidence is available, trace a sample of monitoring alerts through review and disposition.
required_assurance_evidence: Model-specific metrics and thresholds; approval records; baseline and ongoing evaluation reports; monitoring dashboards or logs; drift assessments; review records; maintenance/retraining and corrective-action evidence.
recommendation_titles: Validate predictive and event-correlation functions and monitor their reliability
recommendations: Define the purpose and permitted operational use of each predictive and correlation function; document input data, event definitions and provenance; approve suitable evaluation metrics and thresholds; test representative conditions and error scenarios; establish ongoing performance monitoring, uncertainty communication, maintenance and revalidation triggers.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Each function has documented purposes and evaluation criteria; validation results are compared with approved thresholds; correlation errors and source provenance are assessed; limitations and uncertainty are documented; monitoring and corrective-action responsibilities are assigned and evidenced.

risk_title: AI-related incidents and material changes may not be consistently investigated or controlled
risk_scenario: If an AI-related failure, unexpected output or material change occurs without a sufficiently documented and implemented process for reporting, triage, investigation, approval, rollback and follow-up, the issue may remain unresolved or recur without clear accountability.
control_status: Logging, testing and model-lifecycle requirements are specified; function-specific incident management, change accountability and effectiveness remain unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No incident taxonomy or reporting workflow, triage/escalation procedure, accountable owner map, change approval record, impact assessment, rollback procedure or post-incident review evidence has been reviewed.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain incident management and change-control procedures; confirm accountable roles, severity criteria, escalation and notification routes; inspect incident records, model/configuration changes, approval and validation evidence, rollback plans and post-incident reviews.
assurance_test_titles: AI-related incident investigation and material-change control
assurance_test_objectives: Determine whether incidents and changes affecting AI-enabled functions have defined ownership, escalation, impact assessment, verification and closure procedures.
assurance_test_procedures: Review incident and change-management procedures, role assignments, severity criteria, approval and rollback rules, and post-incident review requirements. If records are available and access is authorised, trace a sample of relevant incidents or changes from identification through assessment, approval, testing, implementation, monitoring and closure.
required_assurance_evidence: Incident taxonomy and workflow; accountable role map; incident and change records; impact assessments; approval history; test evidence; rollback/fallback procedures; post-incident reviews; corrective-action tracking.
recommendation_titles: Establish accountable AI incident and material-change governance
recommendations: Define and assign responsibilities for reporting, classifying, escalating and investigating AI-related incidents and unexpected outputs. Establish a proportionate change process covering impact assessment, approval, validation, rollback or fallback planning, post-incident review and corrective-action tracking. Ensure relevant decisions and outcomes are traceable through appropriate records.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: Accountable roles and escalation routes are documented; incident and change procedures define required assessments and approvals; material changes have traceable validation and rollback/fallback considerations; corrective actions are tracked and closure is evidenced.

risk_title: External data-source quality or provenance may distort analysis if sources are used by Public Safety
risk_scenario: If external tourism, mobility, crime or other indicators are incorporated into Public Safety analysis without adequate provenance, freshness, suitability and quality checks, the resulting analysis or prioritisation may be misleading.
control_status: Connection of the listed external sources to Module #32 is unverified; data provenance, freshness, suitability and quality controls for any such integration are also unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No interface mapping, source lineage, data dictionary, freshness/quality thresholds, validation results, ownership information or monitoring evidence has been reviewed for a connection between Annex I sources and Public Safety.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain Module #32 interface mappings and source lineage; establish whether Annex I sources are used; if so, identify source owners, fields, refresh frequency, quality/freshness checks, transformations, validation rules and monitoring.
assurance_test_titles: External indicator integration, provenance and data-quality validation
assurance_test_objectives: Establish whether an integration exists before assessing its data-quality controls or influence on Public Safety outputs.
assurance_test_procedures: First obtain authoritative interface mappings and determine whether Annex I sources are connected to Module #32. If no connection is evidenced, record the dependency as unverified and do not infer that the risk pathway is active. If a connection is confirmed, trace selected data fields from source to use, inspect source ownership and refresh frequency, review validation and transformation rules, and assess monitoring and error handling.
required_assurance_evidence: Module #32 interface mappings; data lineage and data dictionary; source owner and provenance records; data refresh/freshness rules; transformations and validation logic; data-quality monitoring results; documented use of indicators in analysis or prediction.
recommendation_titles: Establish whether Annex I indicators feed Public Safety and validate any confirmed dependency
recommendations: Obtain authoritative interface mappings to determine whether any Annex I external source or indicator is connected to Module #32. If a connection is confirmed, document the purpose, source owner, fields, provenance, refresh frequency, transformations, data-quality checks and monitoring. If no connection can be evidenced, retain the dependency as unresolved and do not assume that the listed sources feed Public Safety.
recommendation_acceptance_criteria: The presence or absence of the interface is supported by authoritative evidence; any confirmed source has documented lineage, ownership, purpose, freshness and quality criteria; monitoring and exception handling are evidenced where applicable.
